procedure: Run each arm as independent parent plus late-swing actor on each identical frozen course, 72 Isaac episodes total. Verify source/asset/actor/ball-course hashes, body trace and independently reconstructed frame-30 proprioceptive decision. No outcome-aware selection or parameter retuning during collection.
gate: Complete 12/12 paired courses; zero baseline-clean to non-foot losses; zero new out-of-play; minimum pelvis >= 0.65m; switch high quality on >=3/5 gain cases; protect >=6/7 risk cases relative to baseline. Consumed development gate cannot authorize promotion or video.
